latest_features: New ShulkDub1 admin-only module: automatically finds nearby containers, opens them, and drops up to 27 items per cycle with configurable search radius and drop delay
HUD Inventory view now displays a clean 3x9 grid with item icons, stack counts (x# labels), and independent opacity control
Container detection covers chest, trapped chest, ender chest, hopper, and shulker box block types with distance-based nearest-neighbor selection
Admin access enforcement via policy: ShulkDub1 visible only to whitelisted admin users
